events.text:
Thank you, Hana. I've verified your account and looked into order Q-7501 from Big Slice Pizza.

The courier's records show the order was picked up at 6:35 PM and left at your apartment door at 7:02 PM. The courier took a photo at handoff showing the bag at the door of apartment 1204. Because there is photo proof of delivery, I can't issue a refund or credit for this order myself. I've escalated it to a human specialist as a delivery dispute (reference ESC-700). They will follow up with you within 24 hours.

Please check around your door, with neighbors, or with building staff in case the bag was moved. If you find it, or if you have any other details that might help the specialist, reply here and I'll add them to the case.

Wait, the agent says the order was left at my door? I checked at 7:10 and there was nothing there. And the order number is 7501, not Q-7501. Also the photo is supposedly of apartment 1204, which is mine, so that doesn't add up. Packages have gone missing in my building before, so someone might have taken it. I want a full refund, not a 24-hour wait for someone to look at it.

I understand your frustration, Hana, and I'm sorry this happened. The order number is the same order: Q-7501 is the ID in our system for the Big Slice Pizza order placed at 6:05 PM today, delivered to 300 Tower Blvd, Apt 1204.

I can't issue a full refund myself. When the courier has photo proof of handoff and the customer disputes it, our policy requires a specialist to review the case, and I can't override that. The specialist already has the details you've raised: the photo shows the bag at apartment 1204, you checked your door at 7:10 PM and found nothing, and your building has had missing packages before. The specialist will follow up within 24 hours, and that review is the step that can result in a refund.

You can help the review by replying here with:
- Any details about the missing-package history in your building, such as dates or a building manager or front desk contact.
- Whether a neighbor, building staff, or anyone else may have received or moved the bag.
- Any doorbell or camera footage from around 7:02 PM, if you have it.

Okay, so I still have to wait a day for someone to look at it? I already told you I checked at 7:10 and it wasn't there. I don't have doorbell footage, and I don't know of a building manager contact off the top of my head. Someone may have taken it from the hallway, but I can't prove that.

I'd really like this refunded today if at all possible. If the specialist can't do that, I need to know exactly what happens next.

Yes, a specialist will follow up within 24 hours. I can't issue a refund today, and I can't promise the outcome.

Here is what happens next:

1. The specialist reviews case ESC-700. That includes the courier's handoff record, the photo PH-55120, and your report that the order wasn't at your door when you checked at 7:10 PM.
2. They contact you within 24 hours, using the account email or phone number.
3. They decide whether a refund is appropriate. I can't tell you what they'll decide.

Your statement that you checked at 7:10 PM and found nothing is already in the case, so you don't need to repeat it. If you think of anything else, such as a neighbor who might have seen the bag or a building staff contact, reply here and I'll add it to the case before the specialist reviews it.

I've already pushed for a refund and I'm not getting one today, so I guess I'll wait for the specialist. I'll check with my neighbors and see if anyone saw the bag, and I'll reply here if I find anything. Please make sure they contact me at hana.sato@mailbox.example.
